shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && (cat package.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no package.json")

cat index.html && echo ---VITE--- && cat vite.config.ts && echo ---TSCONFIG--- && cat tsconfig.json && echo ---GITIGNORE--- && cat .gitignore && echo ---SRC--- && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat "{}"' && echo ---AGENT--- && ls -la __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules | head -50 && ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | head -40

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.js | head -20; grep -oE '\-\-g-color-(text-primary|text-secondary|base-background|base-generic|line-generic|base-brand)\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles/styles.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles
rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E 'playwright|puppeteer' ; echo "probe done")
